premises.text: Unpredictable supply and volatile prices threaten food businesses; soft commodities are hard to hedge on exchanges
premises.evidence_span: Less than 8% of the world's commodities are traded. And even when they are, even in a place like Chicago, quite often, as a business, you're in a different country, or you're operating in a different currency. And that creates basis risk

premises.text: Index insurance platform with 3000+ country-local indexes automatically pays the difference when prices breach the chosen threshold
premises.evidence_span: a food business is worried about the price going over 200 euros a ton. And in November, it went up to 210. The difference is, of course, 10, and we pay out automatically to replace that lost income

premises.text: Distribution mixes direct corporate sales and aggregator channels for farmers
premises.evidence_span: we sell B2B to corporate clients, and for farmers, obviously huge cost of acquisition problem, we go through aggregators

premises.text: Clients set duration, volume, and trigger price via a simple slider while algos auto-price using simulations, futures, and diversification
premises.evidence_span: You can move the slider to create your exact protection. And behind the scenes, our algos are pricing that automatically

value.text: Protect food businesses' income and deliver financial confidence to invest
value.evidence_span: if you're going to invest in technology, you need the confidence to place that investment. So Stable is delivering financial confidence to our clients

causal_links.evidence_span: pay out automatically to replace that lost income

notes: UX and algo pricing merged as one learnable commercial/pricing module.
